name: Mist Trail to Vernal and Nevada Falls
why: Granite steps through the spray of Vernal Fall, then up beside Nevada Fall to stand where the Merced River drops 181 m.
book: No permit. Free valley shuttle to Happy Isles. Peak-season reservation for driving into the park on some days: check nps.gov/yose.
water: Drinking water at the Vernal Fall footbridge (summer only).
dangers: Wet, slippery steps in the mist: a rain jacket in spring.
People have died swimming above the falls: never enter the river.
The Mist Trail closes in winter: take the John Muir Trail.
